title: Comparison Matrix v1 (comparison-matrix-v1)
description: Structural contract for the reviewable comparison matrix persisted at knowledge/comparison-matrix.json. It is NOT a model output: buildComparisonMatrix (src/comparison/matrix.ts:113) assembles it deterministically from the registry, PaperCards and the stored manuscript, the researcher edits the file, and `--confirm` applies it — so the required set covers what the writer and the applying code dereference, not what a prompt asked for. What is checked: inputHash (staleness gate), entries with the classification/rationale/origin/sources every apply step reads, blockers (confirm refuses while any exist) and the context block the CLI prints. What is deliberately NOT checked: that a classification agrees with the registry status, that a rationale is non-blank for excluded/blocked, that sources cite existing papers or that inputHash matches current state — those are state-machine and freshness rules in assertMatrixApprovable/applyComparisonMatrix. No minItems on entries: an empty matrix is a real state, reported as a blocker with a recovery command.

generatedAt.description: Wall clock; excluded from inputHash on purpose.

classification.description: applyComparisonMatrix branches on all four; an unlisted value would silently leave the registry untouched.
